summary_en: ROE target to remain above 7–9% estimated WACC; FY3/26 ROE 17.3%, PBR 2.95x (3.02x as of 17 Jun 2026). FY3/27 dividend raised to 20 yen/share; interim ordinary dividend FY3/26 increased 14→18 yen/share. Plan focuses on landfill waste intake expansion, organic growth, and shareholder dialogue to lift PBR; interim ROE decline expected from planned capex for new waste-processing facilities.
title_en: Response to Realizing Management Conscious of Cost of Capital and Share Price
translation_en_brief:
MIDAC Holdings disclosed a capital cost and share-price management update on 18 June 2026. The company analyzed its estimated WACC of 7–9% against actual performance: FY3/26 ROE stood at 17.3% (down from 20.3% in FY3/25), and PBR at period end was 2.95x (3.02x as of 17 June). The company reaffirms ROE as a key performance metric targeting 15% and aims to sustain ROE above its WACC despite anticipated mid-term ROE compression from planned capex for new waste-processing facilities.

Key initiatives: (1) Achieve FY3/27 targets of 10 billion yen revenue and 5 billion yen operating profit by securing waste intake expansion at its Okuyama-no-Mori landfill; (2) Continue stable dividends with FY3/26 ordinary dividend raised from 14 to 18 yen/share, and FY3/27 forecast to 20 yen/share; (3) Expand investor relations, launch integrated reporting, and conduct semi-annual earnings briefings and individual meetings to deepen investor understanding and improve shareholder base stability. The company states it will pursue sustainable growth and long-term enterprise value by balancing retained earnings accumulation with shareholder returns.
